Now formatting: The instruction says reproduce tables as HTML <table> markup. I should use HTML tables for the characteristics table and revision history.

For the accuracy class circled markings, I'll transcribe as (III) or (IIII). Perhaps use the character ㏢? No. I'll just write (III) or (IIII) noting they're circled. Since no annotation allowed, just write (III) or (IIII). Maybe use unicode Ⓘ? There's no circled roman numeral III in unicode. Enclosed alphanumerics has ①... but not multi-letter roman numerals. I'll use (III) and (IIII).

Output only the transcription.
